extensionAttribute.description: Returns the full Watchman Monitoring plugin status report from ExportStatus -v.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Watchman Monitoring Full Report Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
exporter="/Library/MonitoringClient/Utilities/ExportStatus"
if [[ -x "$exporter" ]]; then report=$("$exporter" -v 2>/dev/null) echo "<result>${report}</result>" else echo "<result>Watchman Monitoring not installed</result>" fi
